dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concave spline curve from the apex to the posterior basal insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow pixel radius, forming a sharp terminal point at the fin's maximum height.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear ascent at approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 0.78:1 ratio of maximum basal pixel width to maximum vertical pixel height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular white depigmentation patches and mottled scarring concentrated on the lateral body flank and along the anterior margin of the dorsal fin.
